summary: Session 1 of 3 delivered: (1) docs/planning/object-cleanup-strategy.md — design spec for AccessHarvester identify-cleanup with three signal families (NamePattern with five implementation-safe regex sub-patterns, DateMaximaSampler with COM primary / DAO LastUpdated fallback, CrossReferenceAbsenceDetector with inline-SQL parsing and event-property binding paths), confidence-tier algorithm, output format mapping, CLI surface, and degradation-observability via top-level degradationNotes array; (2) AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Cleanup/object-cleanup-schema.json — JSON Schema (draft-07) for object-cleanup.json with tagged-union Signal oneOf discrimination. Verification: gpt-5-4 four rounds. R1 ISSUES_FOUND 4 Major + 2 Minor (regex contract, cross-reference matrix, Subarea polarity, harvestDate type, CLI mutex, degradationNotes); all fixed. R2 ISSUES_FOUND 2 Major + 1 Minor (year-month numeric month-first, event-property predicate, §10 prereq scope); all fixed. R3 ISSUES_FOUND 1 Major + 2 Minor (global code-behind exclusion, bidirectional SQL impact, maxValue timezone); all fixed. R4 ISSUES_FOUND 1 Minor (example day-count arithmetic 1080→1535); fixed post-R4. R5 not run; the byte-trivial arithmetic correction is post-verification per user closeout authorization. No code changes — strategy + schema only. dotnet build clean; 3 pre-existing CLI integration tests against HomeHealthCare time out under test-harness parallelism (direct CLI invocation succeeds in <30s) — disclosed as out-of-scope in every verification round.

reason.specifics: Session 2 implements the Session 1 strategy verbatim in C# under AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Cleanup/ — mechanical correspondence work (regex constants, IR file readers, output writers, unit tests).
